sloka: वराहेण दशग्रीवः शिंशुमारेण चेन्द्रजित् ।उष्ट्रेण कुम्भकर्णश्च प्रयातो दक्षिणां दिशम् ।। ५.२७.३०।।।।
transliteration: varāheṇa daśagrīvaḥ śiṁśumāreṇa cendrajit ।uṣṭreṇa kumbhakarṇaśca prayāto dakṣiṇāṁ diśam ।। 5.27.30।।।।

translations.english: "The tennecked Ravana was seen (this time) riding on a boar, Indrajit on a crocodile and Kumbhakarna on a camel all set towards the southerly direction.
